name: Ahmed Khabbaz
source:
Ahmed Khabbaz is a professional European football player and one of Your Character's love interests. He is first seen in Chapter 1. 

According to Mathieu, Ahmed has a good heart and would always help someone in need. Ahmed is also shown to have a playful and athletic personality. He tells Your Character and their friends that he wants to wait until marriage to go "all the way" with a person, and wants a deep emotional connection with someone before becoming physical. His teammates tease him about being a romantic. Back home, his whole community revolved around life at the mosque; now that he is a professional athlete, he feels it's hard to feel a part of any community outside his team. 

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Ahmed_Khabbaz]Wiki[/url]]
